Name: The Man The Morris (Portrait Replacer For Morris)
Author: Sable17
Description:
[quote][size=4]I'm [b][color=#6d9eeb]Morris[/color][/b], branch Manager... and the man trying to drag this town into the present.[/size][/quote]
[b]Portrait [/b]and [b]sprite [/b]replacer for [b][color=#6d9eeb]Morris[/color][/b]!
   • Includes [b]Seasonal [/b]outfits for base game Morris.
   • [b]Optional [/b]toggle in GMCM to edit Morris' base game dialogue & summit dialogue. Enabled by default.

[b]Optional dialogue edits [/b]changes his base game greetings and summit dialogue. Less cartoon-y villain, more suave businessman.

[b][color=#6d9eeb]Supports[/color][/b]
   •  Stardew Valley Expanded
   •  Marry Morris
   •  Morris Redeemed
   •  A Little More Cutscenes
   •  Across the Aisle
   •  Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic
   •  Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE 
   •  Seasonal Outfits for SVE (Vanilla Style)
          NOTE: Keep Morris enabled in the GMCM for Seasonal Outift mods! 

[b][color=#6d9eeb]Requirements[/color][/b]
   •  Stardew Valley 1.6+
   •  SMAPI
   •  Content Patcher
   •  GMCM - for the mod config menu

[b]Credits[/b]
   •  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/138007818]LynnNexus[/url] for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31774]Seasonal Morris Tod[/url]! I've used the overworld sprites (with permission) from this lovely mod as a base for my overworld sprites. Please check out that awesome version of Morris and don't forget to endorse it!
   •  The [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] team for such a mindblowing mod and it's additions to the Joja route!
   •  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12824]Marry Morris[/url] for the dedication to the man!
   •  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12667]Morris Redeemed[/url] for giving him another chance!
   •  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30369]A Little More Cutscenes[/url] because it's just so well done and has a little Joja content!
   •  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37296?tab=files]Across the Aisle[/url] for star crossed lovers!

[b]Info[/b]
These are portraits/sprites and a sampling of dialogue that I will be using in a romancable Morris mod I'm currently working on.
I figured some folks would just enjoy the portraits standalone!

Let me know of any issues!
